column4: learned lèi from 累官中书舍人 etc.; 累官 "to rise in office step by step" is lěi (now a word in overrides.tsv)
learned cuán from 塔顶为攒尖顶; 他为攒够银子 is zǎn: 为 is a function word (攒尖 is a word)
learned nián from 机车的粘着系数 (adhesion); 衣服粘着泥 is zhān: 着 is a function word
learned mí from the Wusun names 翁归靡和, 军须靡和; 和 is a function word
learned jùn from names (曾毓隽的, 裴延隽的); 的 is a function word
learned pāo from lake names (大屯泡是, 张家窑泡是); 水泡是, 气泡是 are pào: 是 is a function word
